subject.title: Cron running_at_ms not cleared after agentTurn run

question: Should maintainers proceed through the open closing PR for this cron state bug, or require a more exact live reproduction of the reporter's single scheduled `agentTurn` case first?
rationale: Source proves a real stale-marker class and a closing PR already owns it, but the report's exact one-job release scenario is not independently reproduced and the open PR still has correctness/proof blockers.

options.title: Review and repair the closing PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100597 as the canonical fix path, preserving current timer safeguards and adding real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Require exact live reproduction first
options.body: Keep the issue blocked on a live v2026.6.11 or current-main reproduction of the single-cron scenario before accepting the candidate root cause.

options.title: Adopt the older proven branch
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/81572 as source material only if maintainers prefer its live proof and are willing to rebase it through current cron safeguards.

recommendation.title: Review and repair the closing PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100597 as the canonical fix path, preserving current timer safeguards and adding real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The original cron scheduler surface and prior running-state repair history make this the strongest available routing candidate for deciding proof sufficiency and canonical fix path.
